caption: The drawing depicts a single, symmetrical, ornate metal object resembling a hinge or decorative fitting, positioned vertically on a plain off-white or beige background. The object is predominantly rusty brown in color, indicative of aged or weathered metal. Its central vertical bar widens at the top, splitting into three stylized, upward-pointing segments, each ending in a pointed, leaf-like shape. Two horizontal arms extend outward and curve downward from the central stem, each with a rounded protrusion beneath the curve and tapering to a point at the ends. There is a rectangular plate at the lower part of the central bar, and the bottom part of the object extends straight downward, ending in a vertical strip. Circular holes are present in both the upper and central parts of the object, possibly for mounting or fitting purposes. The object is centered on the page, with the background left blank and unadorned.
title: Cast Iron Cresting
